name: Avenge My Village
label: Quest
description: Makaba Flathoof barely survived a vicious assault when raiders from the Grimtotem clan fell upon his village in the southeastern Stonetalon Mountains.…
intro: Makaba Flathoof barely survived a vicious assault when raiders from the Grimtotem clan fell upon his village in the southeastern Stonetalon Mountains. Cut off from his kin and surrounded by the dead, he asks Horde travelers to strike back at the encampment of Grimtotem ruffians and hired sellswords to avenge his fallen people.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
Friend, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, I thank you... But I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
